messages.author: 4719990e9dfe6605
messages.subject: Intercept for four-way cross
parts:
Dear Karl,

I am trying to figure out what the intercept is in the results of fitqtl for a four-way cross. Here is an example of what I get as an output:

 Intercept 1...@82.0.BC 1...@82.0.AD 1...@82.0.BD
 -62.56465  254.87756   79.25001  242.06471


At first, I thought it was the mean value across all individuals, but it is clearly not that. Is it instead the mean value for the AC genotype?

Thanks a ton,

David

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Intercept for four-way cross
parts:
The intercept from fitqtl, for a 4-way cross, would be the average for individuals that have genotype AC at all QTL.

regards,
karl
